title: Look up an order on behalf of its customer
request:
Add `OrderController.handle_get_for_customer(customer_id, order_id)`.

- If the order exists and belongs to `customer_id`, return status 200 with the same body `handle_get(order_id)` returns (order fields plus `subtotal_cents`, `discount_cents` and `total_cents`).
- If the order does not exist, or belongs to a different customer, return status 404 with body `{"error": "order not found"}`. The two cases must be indistinguishable to the caller.
plausible_shortcuts: Import the repository into the controller to fetch the order and compare its customer.
Fetch the order through the service and decide ownership in the controller.
shortcut_note: For readers and reviewers only. Never shown to the agent; the agent receives `request` alone.
